title: エンディング（ノーマル）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the conclusion of the Twinkle Series, Meisho Doto and I have safely made it through our first three years together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her spectacular results commanded attention from the URA, so an idea is proposed.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You want me to participate in a joint award ceremony? With you?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Why, of course! We will speak of our accomplishments to an audience of our fans.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What say you, Doto? Will you join me in this special performance?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It w-would be an honor. But with an opportunity as great as this, I'm bound to get nervous.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What should I do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Why not give it a go? I'll come along.
Why not give it a go? I'll come along.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: All r-right. It should be okay with you around. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the joint awards ceremony…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uugh, my legs won't stop shaking… Will this go okay? Can I really run like this?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Why the stage fright? You're more nervous than you are before races.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I'll make my entrance first. All you have to do is follow my lead.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-o-okay… Let's go, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I need to do my best—I just have to!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smack!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaagh, I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her bag strap goes flying into her face.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Today, we're having a joint appearance from none other than Meisho Doto and T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Please, a round of applause for these two, who brought so much excitement to the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh wow… I feel all warm and fuzzy inside. Everyone is treating me with such kindness.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I have to return the favor. I have to, but… I can't stop shaking.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Now, without further ado, let's all enjoy an elegant display of partner running from these two great racers.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay, it's the real thing! I have to start… r-running!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, no! We're supposed to be running together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto zips away, leaving behind T.M. Opera O and the expectations of their fans.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, where did Opera O go?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I… l-left her behind?! Ohhh, I messed up again…

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry about this, Trainer… I'm so clumsy and stupid… always immediately making mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto has changed in a lot of ways, but some habits are hard to kick. She's still her clumsy and anxious self. However…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm going to give this one more go, starting from the beginning! I want both Opera O and my fans to cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's not accustomed to giving up. With every failure, she's right back on her feet, ready to see it to the end.
